nodes.label: ZCH
nodes.rationale: Single Rust binary TUI dashboard for competitive programming in Zed on macOS: receives problems, runs samples with timings, submits to Codeforces.

nodes.label: Content-hash Compile Cache
nodes.rationale: Caches binary by source hash + flags so unchanged code replays every case instantly.

nodes.label: Compile Flag Tags (no hidden flags)
nodes.rationale: Nothing is added implicitly; flags are validated tags and the Codeforces language id is derived from the last -std= tag (C++17->54, C++20->89, C++23->91).

nodes.label: Large Output Preview and Spill
nodes.rationale: ~24KB preview per box, viewer keeps up to 10MB/20k lines, larger output spilled to temp file and paged with per-page diff.

nodes.label: Precompiled Headers (PCH) Tip
nodes.rationale: Shared PCH cuts bits/stdc++.h compile ~0.3s->0.1s; must match std/arch/compiler; GCC rejects Clang PCH.

nodes.label: Safari AppleScript Automation
nodes.rationale: Only Safari can run JavaScript in background via Apple Events without stealing focus; other browsers would foreground mid-solve.

nodes.label: Single-channel Actor Architecture (PassingCommand)
nodes.rationale: UI thread owns all state; receiver/runner/submitter workers only exchange PassingCommand envelopes, no worker holds a handle to another.

nodes.label: syspolicyd Latency Tip
nodes.rationale: macOS security scans add ~200ms on new binaries; adding Zed/terminal to Developer Tools drops latency to 3-4ms.

nodes.label: graphify update (AST-only refresh)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the graph current after code changes at no API cost; graph.json is rewritten whole each build so large diffs are expected.

nodes.label: Graphify Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Query the scoped graph (query/path/explain) before grep or raw reads because it returns a much smaller subgraph than GRAPH_REPORT.md or grep output.
